subject: Proposed POC timeline & next steps — BrightBridge evaluation
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightbridge.ai>, Jenna Lowe <jenna.lowe@brightbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & proposed POC schedule (BrightBridge)

Thanks again for the call today — appreciate the clarity on the three key evaluation goals. Quick recap and a concrete proposal so we can lock the kickoff date.

High-level success criteria (from today's call)
- Accuracy: end-to-end retrieval + generation pass rate >= 85% on your 200-case prompt set
- Latency: P50 < 350ms for interactive queries in the default dataset slice
- Integration: connector for BrightBridge data pipelines and role-based access for testers

Proposed POC timeline (compact, 3-week run)
1) Kickoff (Day 0): technical onboarding, sample data ingestion, credential handoff
2) Week 1: model tuning/ingestion + baseline readouts (metrics + smoke tests)
3) Week 2: feature validation with BrightBridge prompts + performance tuning
4) Week 3: acceptance runs, final readout, handoff notes / next steps

Cadence and owners
- Weekly check-ins: 30min, Tuesdays 10:00am PT (Marissa will run these)
- Day-to-day support: Olga (SRE) will provision test env and handle access
- Success criteria & acceptance: Jenna (BrightBridge PO) + Samir (BrightBridge tech lead)
- Redwood contact: Marcus (sales, coordination) + Marissa (CS lead)

Attachments: BB-POC-success-criteria.docx, BB-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (see attached)

Immediate asks / next steps
- Please review the attached success criteria and mark any changes inline by EOD Mon (Mar 26)
- Confirm a kickoff date in the week of Apr 1 — options below
  * Tue Apr 2, 10:00am PT
  * Thu Apr 4, 10:00am PT
  * Fri Apr 5, 10:00am PT

If those work, I’ll send a calendar invite and the minimal pre-kickoff checklist (data samples, service account, and IP allowlist).

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 09:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposed POC schedule (BrightBridge)

Thanks Marcus — useful summary and great to see a tight timeline. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Success criteria: the accuracy target looks right; would like an extra bullet for data-skew checks on our low-frequency queries
- Data/sample ask: we can provide a 10k-record sample + a small traffic replay (sanitized) — is that sufficient?
- Deployment question: for the POC, can we run on a dedicated instance (ephemeral) and confirm a documented data deletion policy post-POC?

Availability: Apr 4 and Apr 5 (10:00am PT) both work for us — prefer Apr 5 if possible.

If you need any legal/compliance template items in advance, flag them and I’ll loop in procurement.

Provisioning & capacity
